description: This file is a C header (.h) file defining interfaces for the Telephony Voice Manager HAL library, including function prototypes, include directives, and macro definitions.

methods.name: telcovoicemgrhal_initdata
methods.description: Initializes voice manager HAL data with a status parameter.

methods.name: telcovoicemgrhal_getlinestats
methods.description: Retrieves line statistics given a parameter name and fills a stats structure.

methods.name: telcovoicemgrhal_getcapabilities
methods.description: Fetches capabilities into the provided capabilities structure based on a parameter name.

methods.name: telcovoicemgrhal_getvoiceprofile
methods.description: Retrieves voice profile information for a specified voice service index and parameter name.

methods.name: telcovoicemgrhal_getphyinterface
methods.description: Gets physical interface details for a given voice service index and parameter name.
